# Wick Knight, phase 3: the three game parts for the scene (never saved: run with --no-save).
# Each arm gets its origin at its shoulder and is moved to the world origin, so its GLB's
# geometry is relative to the pivot the game turns it about. Generated by make_hero.py.
select HeroBody
export hero_body.glb --selection
select SwordArm
active SwordArm
cursor set -0.4 0.0 0.9
origin set --to cursor
set location 0 0 0
export hero_armr.glb --selection
select ShieldArm
active ShieldArm
cursor set 0.4 0.0 0.9
origin set --to cursor
set location 0 0 0
export hero_arml.glb --selection
